fields.name: eventTime
fields.description: Zeek event timestamp, ISO-8601 UTC, millisecond precision

fields.name: sensor
fields.description: Sensor that observed the connection; archived as its own column so training never splits eventId

fields.name: logType
fields.description: Which Zeek log produced this event. Vocabulary: conn, ssh, dns, http, modbus, s7comm. Only conn is implemented today; the field exists so the contract never needs a v2 when the others land

fields.name: connectionUid
fields.description: Zeek uid, the cross-protocol correlation key for one connection. Empty string when a log type carries none. NOT a record id — several dns/http records share one uid

fields.name: schemaId
fields.description: Feature schema id, always conn-feature-v1 for this contract version

fields.name: schemaHash
fields.description: SHA-256 of the canonical feature schema, 64 lowercase hex characters

fields.name: qualityFlags
fields.description: Bitfield reserved for per-vector quality signals; 0 today

fields.name: producedAt
fields.description: Emission time, ISO-8601 UTC. Archived as row_version, so the latest emission wins deduplication
